status_policy: Every item is reference material; no generated image is canon until a human promotes it.

items.title: Agreement Compounds
items.alt: On a sunny San Diego terrace, dozens of small cream robots assemble interlocking wooden blocks into a long viaduct while a round-headed figure in a hoodie puzzles over one block and Tlatoāni lounges in an armchair eating cookies.
items.description: Many Mācrons each add the same small interlocking piece, and the pieces compound into a bridge that reaches a café across the bay. The hooded figure is still trying to understand one block; Tlatoāni has already relaxed, trusting the agreement between pieces. Small agreed-upon units, repeated, build something no single agent could.
items.text_in_image: SAN DIEGO
canon_qa: Mācron count far exceeds the 3–5 guideline (swarm arguably justified by the concept)
the hooded figure has a cream Mācron-like ball head with a hook antenna, blurring who is a robot
Tlatoāni wears a large feathered ceremonial headdress in a casual scene
busy background (city skyline, café, laptop stickers) competes with the main idea

items.title: Baby Mācrons
items.alt: Tlatoāni and apprentice Covi chat on a sofa holding Fedora mugs while two small cream-and-teal Mācron robots on the rug both tug at the same toy computer, each pointing at the āi on its own chest.
items.description: Two Mācrons want the same toy computer and each insists it is theirs, mirroring the pointing-at-each-other meme. Above them Tlatoāni and Covi keep talking calmly. Two agents contending for one shared resource is a coordination problem, not a character flaw.
items.text_in_image: fedora · āi
canon_qa: Mācron eyes are angled into an angry glare, close to a threatening face (§41)
Mācron heads carry ear-like side discs
Tlatoāni robe is olive/brown rather than cream
toddler play-rug framing leans toward 'baby' reading that §16/§41 warn against
items.notes: Used on the landing page as /images/learning-together.webp.

items.title: Blue Pill, Red Pill
items.alt: Close-up of Tlatoāni wearing round dark glasses whose lenses reflect a young man offered a red pill and a blue pill.
items.description: Tlatoāni takes the Morpheus role: the choice is shown only in the reflection, and Tlatoāni simply smiles. The image is about choosing to see how the system really works versus staying comfortable.
canon_qa: heavy gold regalia, sun-face medallions and ear spools read as Aztec costume cliché (§7)
visible nostrils add facial clutter
dark, dramatic palette away from the warm workshop style

items.title: Build a Cathedral
items.alt: A small axolotl in a paper hat lays a stone block in the foreground while a dashed-line outline of a Gothic cathedral rises behind medieval builders and a treadwheel crane.
items.description: The cathedral exists only as a dashed blueprint; what is real is one stone being set. Tlatoāni works on the foundation, cheerful, knowing it will take generations. Big systems are built one verified piece at a time toward a shared plan.
items.slogan: Lay the stone. The plan holds the rest.
canon_qa: Tlatoāni's skin is mottled tan/beige rather than pink
teeth visible in a wide grin; face reads less canon-round
plain dirty smock, no cream/teal clothing language

items.title: Burning Tokens
items.alt: A purple axolotl in a starry purple robe happily eats chocolate coins from a jar while a round-headed figure in a hoodie grins in front of monitors showing burning coin icons.
items.description: Every monitor shows coins on fire while Tlatoāni casually unwraps another chocolate coin, foil wrappers piling up on the table. Tokens are the currency of agent work, and they are easy to spend without noticing.
canon_qa: Tlatoāni is purple instead of pink
purple star-pattern robe is off-palette (no cream/teal)
monitor wall with fake dashboard UI text in the background (§31)
the hooded figure's ball head reads as a mascot rather than an established character

items.title: Chess: Tlatoāni vs Mācron
items.alt: In a sunny garden full of hanging Tillandsias, a puzzled pink Tlatoāni studies a chessboard while a small cream robot with a dark screen face smiles beside a jar of teal tokens.
items.description: Tlatoāni concentrates hard on the position; Mācron is already relaxed and pleased, holding a captured token. The scene captures the core contrast: one reasons about consequences, the other has found a move nobody expected.
canon_qa: Mācron's head is a boxy CRT-like rectangle rather than a rounded shell
Mācron's antenna is a leaf sprout instead of a small orb
front gill lobes are large and ear-like
items.notes: Used on the landing page as /images/garden-chess.webp. Strongest Tlatoāni anatomy reference in the set: pink body, gills, one tail, cream/teal robe.

items.title: Developers! Developers! Developers!
items.alt: A bald man in a blue shirt shouts on stage in front of a screen reading DEVELOPERS! three times while Tlatoāni claps happily in a cheering conference audience.
items.description: A recreation of the famous keynote chant, with Tlatoāni enjoying the energy from the seats. It is about developer ecosystems and the people they are built for.
items.slogan: Build for the people in the seats.
items.text_in_image: DEVELOPERS! DEVELOPERS! DEVELOPERS! · Microsoft · // BUILD 2011 ATTENDEE
canon_qa: depicts a recognizable real person and a corporate trademark; unsafe for promotion
large feathered headdress in a casual audience scene

items.title: Fedora Up
items.alt: A photorealistic close-up of Tlatoāni's smiling lower face and pink gills beneath a blue felt fedora with an embroidered Fedora logo.
items.description: A cinematic close-up: the hat hides the eyes, leaving only the smile and gills. It is a brand nod to Fedora as the home operating system of the workshop.
canon_qa: photorealistic rendering, outside the cartoon style (§42 'overly realistic')

items.title: Ford Production Line
items.alt: A sepia photograph-style scene in which an elderly man in a suit points out a Model T on an assembly line staffed by many small round robots, while a robed axolotl in a fedora watches from behind.
items.description: An early-1900s assembly line where every station is a Mācron doing one well-defined step. Tlatoāni watches the man who designed the line explain it. Splitting work into small, repeatable stages is how many agents produce one coherent result.
items.slogan: One step per station. One car at the end.
canon_qa: Mācron count far exceeds 3–5 (swarm is the concept)
sepia treatment removes pink, cream and teal, so neither character's palette reads
Tlatoāni seen only from behind; silhouette depends on the hat

items.title: I'm Trying to Tell You You Won't Have To
items.alt: Tlatoāni, eyes closed and smiling, raises one palm and stops a hail of bullets frozen in mid-air.
items.description: The bullet-stop scene from The Matrix with Tlatoāni serene at its center. When you understand the system well enough, you stop dodging problems one at a time.
items.slogan: When you're ready, you won't have to.

items.description: Tlatoāni appears as a jolly king-sage figure walking with Goku in the Dragon Ball world. A playful crossover about mentors and students.
items.slogan: Strength is easy. Direction is training.

items.title: Less Syntax, More Intent
items.alt: A frustrated white round-headed developer rubs his head in front of colorful code while Tlatoāni, crowned and calm, rests a hand on his shoulder and raises the other palm.
items.description: The developer is drowning in syntax; Tlatoāni calmly signals 'pause'. The lesson is to state what you want clearly and let the tools handle the spelling.
canon_qa: gold crown in a desk scene (allowed, but not needed)

items.title: Measurements
items.alt: An angry young purple axolotl in a black hoodie shouts at a computer with a red X speech bubble while an older purple axolotl in a robe rests a hand on his shoulder, thinking of a ruler.
items.description: One axolotl reacts to failure with rage; the other answers with a ruler. Before you fix anything, measure it: anger is not a signal you can act on, but a measurement is.

items.title: Narratives Merge
items.alt: A pixel-art gothic scene: a red-cloaked, white-haired vampire lord stands beside a tall purple-grey axolotl in a tattered cloak, above dialogue reading 'History abhors a paradox' and 'Narratives merge.'
items.description: Kain warns that history abhors a paradox; Tlatoāni answers that narratives merge. Two histories that diverged can be reconciled instead of one erasing the other.

items.title: Panic Fix Is in HEAD
items.alt: A cream robot with an ā on its chest clutches its face in panic beside a terminal showing a context-overflow panic, while Tlatoāni laughs, points, and thinks of the git logo.
items.description: Mācron's run ends in 'panic: context overflow' and it freezes in horror. Tlatoāni is not worried at all: the fix is already committed, so the way back is one git command. Small commits turn panics into jokes.
items.slogan: The fix is already in HEAD.
items.text_in_image: agent@macron:~/task$ run > analyzing... > processing... > applying changes... > building... ! panic: context overflow ! thread 'main' panicked at 'cannot handle this right now' stack backtrace: ... (lots of noise) ... agent@macron:~/task$ · TOKEN · OBSERVE UNDERSTAND MOVE · The Pragmatic Programmer · Designing Data-Intensive Applications

items.description: Tlatoāni calls in on the codec with advice: building the future and keeping the past alive are the same thing. Knowledge only survives if someone writes it down for the next one.

items.title: Preserve Accord
items.alt: On a dirt road, one small robot drags a spiked roller that breaks the paved path back into rubble while another relaxes on a bench with tea, a confused figure kneels with notes, and crowned Tlatoāni gestures calmly.
items.description: Phase 1 breaks rocks down, phase 2 refines and compacts them, but the phase 1 robot keeps rolling over finished road and undoing it. Tlatoāni's thought bubble shows the intended sequence from rock to road. Agents need to preserve each other's work instead of redoing it.
items.slogan: Agents keep undoing each other. Preserve accord.
items.text_in_image: PHASE 1 BREAK DOWN · PHASE 2 REFINE & COMPACT · Agents keep undoing each other. Preserve accord. — Tlatoāni

items.title: Pressing the Red Button

items.title: Tlatoāni and Lamport
items.alt: At a sunny table covered in clocks that all show different times, a puzzled pink Tlatoāni points at one clock while a bearded man in glasses and a plaid shirt watches, with message-passing diagrams overhead.
items.description: Every clock on the table disagrees, so Tlatoāni studies them while the man who invented logical clocks waits. Above them, timelines exchange envelopes. Real time cannot order events across machines; the messages between them can.
items.slogan: Order comes from messages, not clocks.

items.title: Tlatoāni Appearance: Out of Order
items.alt: At sunset, a puzzled white robot with cyan eyes holds a glowing butterfly labeled 10:12 while a swarm of timestamped butterflies forms a big arrow, and crowned Tlatoāni laughs while eating from a jar labeled MOMENTS (NOT ORDERED).
items.description: Moments arrive as butterflies with timestamps in no particular order, yet together they form one clear arrow. Mācron tries to sort them one by one; Tlatoāni enjoys them and sees the direction. Patterns matter more than individual packets.
items.text_in_image: MOMENTS (NOT ORDERED) · PATTERNS > PACKETS · timestamps on butterflies (e.g. 10:12, 8:05, 12:33, 11:59)

items.title: Clean Room Post Box
items.alt: In a sunlit coastal workshop hung with Tillandsias air plants, a miniature glass-and-wood forge room sits on a workbench as one tiny cream-and-teal robot Mācron slides a tied parcel through a brass post slot to a second tiny Mācron outside, watched by pink axolotl Tlatoāni holding a teacup.
items.description: Inside the glass-walled doll-house workbench room, one Mācron slips finished work through a one-way brass post slot while Tlatoāni sips tea safely outside. The forge isolates the workspace from the rest of your home while letting finished work pass cleanly out.

items.title: Arabiya Ink and Voices
items.alt: In a sunlit greenhouse hung with Tillandsias, tiny robot Mācron uses a reed pen to draw a smooth teal curve with one dot below it on a cream sheet beside three glass jars of glowing teal musical notes and a discarded scribble marked with a coral X, while pink axolotl Tlatoāni holds a brass tuning fork.
items.description: Mācron traces a clean Arabic letter curve with a single distinct dot while a chaotic scribble sits rejected to the side, and three stoppered glass jars hold verified musical notes as Tlatoāni listens with a tuning fork. Real stroke geometry and verified local voice clips beat polite shortcuts.
items.slogan: Count the stroke and the dots, not just the ink.

items.title: Demon Attack Wave Balance
items.alt: On a greenhouse workbench, a wooden five-knob dial box sits beside a precarious towering stack of carved wooden space-invader blocks looming over a tiny wooden ship, while tiny robot Mācron arranges blocks into a gentle three-step staircase with a rising teal arrow and pink axolotl Tlatoāni holds brass calipers beside a balance scale.
items.description: Five dials turned up together on the left create a teetering tower of wooden space-invaders on Wave 1; on the right, Mācron and Tlatoāni measure and reshape the blocks into a fair, climbable staircase. Auditing the whole campaign turns compounding multipliers into a balanced curve.
items.slogan: Measure all 318 waves before Wave 1 becomes a wall.

items.title: Ranitas Quiet Pond
items.alt: At twilight beside a calm garden pond hung with Tillandsias in glass globes, pink axolotl Tlatoāni and tiny cream-and-teal robot Mācron sit peacefully on a wooden deck with their feet near the water as two tree frogs sleep on lily pads and an unused wooden peg-scoreboard rests aside.
items.description: As dusk settles and fireflies glow, two little frogs curl up asleep on their lily pads while Tlatoāni and Mācron watch ripples spread across the pond, leaving the peg-scoreboard untouched on the deck. Not every game needs a score or a loss screen; some software knows when to rest.
items.slogan: Both frogs are asleep on time. That is the highest score in the pond.

items.title: Quote Anchors Hold
items.alt: In a sunlit workshop hung with Tillandsias, tiny robot Mācron inserts a new sheet of parchment near the top of an unrolled scroll beside a wooden ruler, while pink axolotl Tlatoāni points to a glowing teal clip anchored directly to a carved sun emblem as the scroll shifts downward.
items.description: When Mācron adds a new sheet at the top of the scroll, the fixed marks on the wooden ruler no longer line up with the drawings—but the glowing teal clip fastened directly to the sun emblem slides down with the emblem and stays true. Anchor documentation to quotes, not line numbers.
items.slogan: Line numbers drift; words stay put.
